mechanism: Betamethasone may increase tetrabenazine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing tetrabenazine efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause CNS effects and tetrabenazine carries risk of depression/psychiatric effects which may be compounded by corticosteroid-induced mood changes.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of tetrabenazine and psychiatric status closely; consider dose adjustment of tetrabenazine if betamethasone is initiated or discontinued; assess for emerging or worsening depression and behavioral changes.
